svg.title: NCP protocol function overview
svg.desc: Informative proposed B01 overview for the UNRELEASED 1.0.0-rc.1 candidate. It shows five shared gates: raw bounds, authenticated ingress, wire and stable-core identity, session and stream checks, and typed delivery. Action adds a sixth, conditional body-effect predicate. The four planes are bounded. Direct production-secure Zenoh ingress is unavailable. This is not implementation, release, or certification evidence.

svg.text: FIVE SHARED GATES · ACTION ADDS THE BODY EFFECT GATE · FOUR PLANES
